<Warning>
  This integration is developed and maintained by ShapeDiver, not Speckle. For support, bug reports,
  or feature requests, contact [ShapeDiver](https://shapediver.com/) directly.
</Warning>

ShapeDiver is a tool that allows you to create Grasshopper web apps. Speckle has worked with the ShapeDiver team to make using Speckle with Grasshopper in their web apps seamless and secure.
